methodologyNotes: Pricing fetched directly from each vendor's official pricing page via WebFetch. Where the official page returned an error or redirect, a reputable 2026 comparison page (GetApp, SoftwareAdvice) was used and noted in provenance. Culture Amp and Motivosity publish no self-serve USD prices; all their plans are recorded as null. Leapsome publishes a per-user base price but the exact interpretation is ambiguous (see notes). Workleap (formerly Officevibe) migrated to a flat annual pricing model; prices are annualized to monthly equivalents. Lattice has a $4,000/year minimum spend. Engagedly has a $7,500/year minimum spend. All accessedAt dates are 2026-06-14.

vendors.name: Culture Amp
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://www.cultureamp.com/pricing fetched 2026-06-14; no USD prices published — all plans are quote-only.

plans.name: Engage
plans.notes: Employee surveys and insights module. Price depends on headcount, product chosen, and service tier. Annual billing only. Quote required.

plans.name: Perform
plans.notes: Performance management module. Quote required. Can be bundled with Engage and/or Develop.

plans.name: Develop
plans.notes: Career development add-on to Engage or Perform. Quote required.

vendors.name: 15Five
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://www.15five.com/pricing/ fetched 2026-06-14. Corroborated by GetApp (https://www.getapp.com/hr-management-software/a/15five/pricing/) and SoftwareAdvice (https://www.softwareadvice.com/employee-engagement/15five-profile/). All three sources agree on per-seat prices. Security page confirmed no HIPAA mention.

plans.name: Engage
plans.notes: Billed annually. Includes employee engagement surveys, targeted assessments, action planning, heat maps, benchmarking. No month-to-month option published.

plans.name: Perform
plans.notes: Billed annually. Most popular plan. Includes AI-assisted performance reviews, OKRs & Goals, 360° Feedback, Talent Matrix, Career Paths. GetApp and SoftwareAdvice corroboration shows $10/user; official page shows $11/user — official page is authoritative.

plans.name: Total Platform
plans.notes: Billed annually. Includes everything in Engage + Perform plus Manager Training Microlearnings and HR outcomes dashboard.

vendors.name: Lattice
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://lattice.com/pricing fetched 2026-06-14 (two separate fetches confirming same data). Corroborated by SoftwareAdvice. Trust center confirmed no HIPAA/BAA. $4,000/year minimum spend stated on official page.

plans.name: Engagement
plans.notes: Billed annually. Includes pulse surveys, onboarding/exit surveys, eNPS, action planning, AI analysis. $4,000/year minimum contract. All prices in USD only.

plans.name: Performance
plans.notes: Billed annually. Includes performance reviews, succession planning, PIPs, talent reviews, calibration. $4,000/year minimum contract.

plans.name: Goals & OKRs
plans.notes: Billed annually. Includes cascading goals, Salesforce and Jira integrations. $4,000/year minimum contract.

plans.name: Compensation (add-on)
plans.notes: Add-on to any base product. Billed annually. Includes global benchmarks, comp bands, cycle management.

plans.name: Grow (add-on)
plans.notes: Add-on to any base product. Billed annually. Includes competencies, IDPs, career tracks, AI-powered growth areas.

vendors.name: Bonusly
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://bonusly.com/pricing fetched 2026-06-14. Corroborated by GetApp (https://www.getapp.com/hr-management-software/a/bonusly/pricing/). Official page shows Team plan at $5/user/month (with Bizy AI) or $3/user/month (without); GetApp corroboration shows $3/user/month for Team (may reflect the non-AI version). Organization plan is quote-only on both sources.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Up to 8 users only. Includes peer recognition, Slack/Teams integrations, mobile apps. Limited features.

plans.name: Team
plans.notes: Base Team plan without Bizy AI add-on is $3/user/month ($30/user/year). Team + Bizy AI is $5/user/month ($50/user/year, effectively 2 months free on annual). Unlimited users. Includes advanced analytics, HRIS integrations, 24/7 support. Month-to-month option available.

plans.name: Organization
plans.notes: Custom pricing, annual billing. Includes everything in Team plus company announcements, awards/incentives, SAML SSO, dedicated CSM, training library. Quote required.

vendors.name: Workleap (formerly Officevibe)
vendors.provenance: Officevibe.com redirects 301 to workleap.com. Official pricing page https://workleap.com/pricing/ fetched 2026-06-14. Pricing is flat annual (not per-seat). No external corroboration source available (G2 and GetApp returned 403/404 for Workleap).

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: Flat $4,999/year billed annually (= $416.58/month). Includes end-to-end performance management, engagement surveys, AI analyses, org chart, goals & OKRs, recognition, 1:1 management, compensation planning. No per-seat pricing.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Flat $11,999/year billed annually (= $999.92/month). Adds advanced intelligence, compensation benchmarking, pay bands, API access, SAML SSO, custom properties.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: For 250+ employees. Custom quote. Includes dedicated CSM, premium support, PO/payment terms, custom security review, sandbox environment.

plans.name: Manager Agent (add-on)
plans.notes: $99/manager/month ($1,188/manager/year). Add-on to any plan. Includes MCP access, proactive insights, performance review drafting, meeting intelligence, advanced memory.

vendors.name: Leapsome
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://www.leapsome.com/pricing fetched 2026-06-14 (three fetches). Page states 'pricing per user starts at $199/month' with currency selector. This is the base platform cost with no HR modules selected; functional modules (HRIS, Reviews, Surveys, Goals, Learning, Compensation) are purchased additionally. The $199/user/month base figure is recorded as stated but likely includes a minimum commitment. Annual contract required. $6,000/year minimum for dedicated CS support. No independent corroboration source returned usable data (GetApp shows 'no pricing info').

plans.name: Platform (base, no modules)
plans.notes: Official page states 'pricing per user starts at $199/month'. This is the base platform with NO functional HR modules included. Modules (HRIS, Reviews, Surveys, Goals, Learning, Compensation) are priced separately. Annual contract required. Multi-module and volume discounts available. $6,000/year minimum for dedicated Customer Success support. 14-day free trial available. The per-user figure at $199 is as stated on the official page; exact per-module incremental costs require a sales quote.

vendors.name: Engagedly
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://engagedly.com/pricing/ fetched 2026-06-14. Corroborated by GetApp (https://www.getapp.com/hr-management-software/a/engagedly/pricing/). Both sources agree on per-seat modular pricing. Official page notes $7,500/year minimum spend.

plans.name: Engage & Listen
plans.notes: Billed annually. Includes engagement surveys, team pulse, employee social, intranet. $7,500/year minimum spend across all selected modules.

plans.name: Recognize & Reward
plans.notes: Billed annually. Includes gamification, badges, reward storefront, praise features. $7,500/year minimum spend.

plans.name: Learn & Grow
plans.notes: Billed annually. Official page shows $3-5/user/month range; GetApp corroboration shows $3/user/month. Includes LXP, growth tools, skill library, 360° feedback. $7,500/year minimum spend.

plans.name: Manage Performance
plans.notes: Billed annually. Official page shows $5-8/user/month range; GetApp corroboration shows $5/user/month. Includes performance reviews, goals/OKRs, meetings, real-time feedback, check-ins. $7,500/year minimum spend.

plans.name: Talent Mobility
plans.notes: Billed annually. Includes skill gap analysis, IDPs, career paths, talent discovery, succession planning. $7,500/year minimum spend.

vendors.name: Motivosity
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://www.motivosity.com/pricing fetched 2026-06-14. Page confirms custom/quote-only pricing. Estimated annual ranges shown on page but no flat published per-seat rate. All plans recorded as null.

plans.name: Custom
plans.notes: All pricing is custom/quote-only. No self-serve published per-seat rate. Modular PEPM structure approximately $0-2 PEPM for platform + $1+ PEPM per additional module. $3,000/year minimum. Contact sales for quote.
